name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: CVE-2026-88779 — Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
items.dek: Citrix NetScaler. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 7 October.

items.title: Not Self-Decidable: LLMs Cannot Draw the Boundary of What an Agent Verifier Can Check
items.dek: LLMs cannot reliably classify whether a runtime rule requires human judgment or automated check; models disagree on regulatory text and over-claim automation capability.
items.unproven: tested only on four model families; whether CoVer's two-evaluator committee generalizes beyond the three specific rule sets examined

items.title: Penumbra: Sample-Efficient Adversarial Search for Regulatory Obligations
items.dek: Adaptive adversarial search finds regulatory compliance boundaries with 1.43x the defeat modes of naive enumeration at matched budget, demonstrated on 60 financial advisory rules.
items.unproven: tested on one financial institution's ruleset; whether defeat modes discovered transfer to other domains or regulatory regimes

items.title: StegoMemory: Agentic Memory Acts as Covert Steganographic Channel
items.dek: 20.1% of steganographic encoding attacks persist through agent memory write and retrieval undetected, including synthetic API keys and cryptographic material.
items.unproven: tested on 13 models but oversights may not reflect deployed safety systems; whether more sophisticated detection mechanisms would catch these channels

items.title: The Same Zero: Why Identical ASR Can Imply Different Guarantees in LLM-Agent Security
items.dek: Schema sandbox plus confirmation gate achieves 0% attack success with full benign utility; VAL framework reveals intuition-based stacks trade off to security-by-luck.
items.unproven: tested on AgentDojo and JADE; whether VAL stack generalizes to agents outside banking or with different permission models

items.title: When Talk Isn't Code: Comparing LLM Agents That Simulate and Develop Software
items.dek: LLMs disclaim security checks in conversation mode they fail to implement in code; median DNS implementation reached 13-15% attack success despite full specification.
items.unproven: limited to four protocol implementations and one attack suite; whether findings extend to generation-time defenses or fine-tuned models

items.title: COPEX: Benchmarking LLM Robustness to Adversarial Context Across Model Context Protocol Layers
items.dek: COPEX benchmark isolates LLM robustness to adversarial context across four MCP entry surfaces; mean attack success rate 64.4% across nine models.
items.unproven: Benchmark tests model susceptibility with fixed orchestration stack; real-world agent robustness with deployed guardrails and production configurations not evaluated; defense effectiveness on full agent pipelines unproven.

items.title: Attestable Audit: Property-Based Attestation for Proprietary Workloads without Artifact Disclosure
items.dek: TEE-based audit binding connects source code digest to fuzzing, static analysis and formal-method verdicts without disclosing proprietary binaries.
items.unproven: concept paper; no implementation, performance measurement, or evidence TEE audits match depth of human code review

items.title: Guess My Weight: Profiled Side-Channel Recovery of Floating-Point Neural-Network Weights
items.dek: Profiled side-channel attack recovers exact IEEE-754 weights from neural networks via power analysis on embedded devices.
items.unproven: Limited to ChipWhisperer lab environment with single microcontroller class; applicability to production deployment, countermeasure effectiveness, and field feasibility undemonstrated.

items.title: GrayShield: Bit-Level Sanitization for Transformer Model Supply-Chain Security
items.dek: GrayShield sanitizes model LSBs post-training to block weight-parameter covert channels; maintains sub-1% accuracy loss with 50-point payload recovery reduction.
items.unproven: Tested on BERT and ViT only; supply-chain threat model assumes compromised training or distribution without real-world attack scenarios; integration into SDLC governance and SAST/SCA tooling chains not addressed.

items.title: Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning: Enhancing Agent Security against Prompt Injection Attacks from Failure Experience
items.dek: Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning framework trains LLM agents to resist prompt injection by learning from failure under adversarial conditions.
items.unproven: Evaluation on static and adaptive benchmarks only; deployment feasibility in production agent orchestration, interaction with prompt guardrails, and long-term robustness against evolving attacks unproven; no comparison to competing defense architectures.

items.title: Xray-core concealed a certificate verification bypass vulnerability
items.dek: Xray-core had a certificate verification bypass; no exploitation details or patch status provided.
items.unproven: whether the vulnerability is exploitable in reader's deployment, patch availability, or prevalence in financial services networks

items.title: Reactivating Alignment: Defending LLMs from Jailbreaks via Intention-Aware Input-Output Matching
items.dek: Intent-aware input-output matching reduces jailbreak success to 5% on HarmBench with low over-refusal; reframes defense as semantic consistency extraction.
items.unproven: evaluated on HarmBench only; whether adaptive attacks targeting input-output semantic pairing succeed; generalization beyond single benchmark

items.title: A Cheat-Sensitive Primitive for Destination-Private Quantum Routing
items.authors: S. F. E. Oliviero et al.
items.dek: Quantum routing primitive tests whether routing provider reads destination via coherent-state cheating detection.
items.unproven: Lacks quantitative information-disturbance tradeoff, composable security proof, and certification against arbitrary attacks; post-quantum cryptography relevance theoretical, no migration planning implications.

items.title: Indistinguishability Lifting for Keyed Oracles, Compressed Ideal Cipher, and More Applications
items.dek: Quantum indistinguishability lifting theorem extends keyed oracle proofs from classical to quantum adversaries; enables compressed ideal cipher with O(q²) loss.

items.title: Post-Quantum Authentication Protocol for Internet of Medical Things
items.dek: Lattice-based post-quantum signature protocol with blockchain for IoMT message authentication; combines known constructs without novel technique or measurement.
items.unproven: no performance benchmarks or comparison to alternative post-quantum approaches; no deployment or security proof beyond design description

items.title: Quantum Machine Learning Protection of Military Quantum Key Distribution Against Cryptographically Camouflaged Attacks
items.dek: Quantum kernel defeats classical monitors of cryptographically camouflaged attacks on QKD generators; theoretical result without hardware implementation or threat model evidence.
items.unproven: simulation only on small bit groups (10-14 bit); no evidence adversary can realistically implant kleptographic foothold in military QKD hardware

items.title: CHAMP: Cayley HAshing with Matrix Products
items.dek: Cayley hash function using matrix products over finite fields with homomorphic properties.
items.unproven: No deployment evidence, cryptanalytic resistance unverified against modern attack classes, performance comparison to production hash families absent.

items.title: JASPER: Special Session on Joint Reliability And Security Assessment of SPlit Computing for Edge Robustness
items.dek: Joint reliability and security framework for split neural-network computing measures fault injection and adversarial attack impact.
items.unproven: Evaluation limited to ResNet-50 and single application domain; generalization to other architectures, deployment models, and edge configurations not established; mitigation strategies absent.

items.title: Modeling Deletion Requests in Machine Unlearning
items.dek: Machine unlearning analysis models adaptive and collective user deletion requests; shows data valuation techniques enable behavior modification.
items.unproven: Experiments on computer vision tasks only; no financial services, compliance, or GDPR-process implications established; interaction with production model governance and audit trails unexamined.

items.title: Autonomous Active Directory Exploitation via Multi-Model Harness Orchestration: A Benchmark Study with NeuroSploit on GOAD
items.dek: LLM agents autonomously exploit Active Directory against GOAD lab using orchestrated attack chains; no evidence of evasion against defenses in production.
items.unproven: Red team findings do not establish exploit success against hardened, monitored directory services; lab environment lacks incident detection and response.

items.title: Learning to Watermark Speech Synthesis Against Model-Driven Reconstruction
items.dek: Multi-bit watermarking framework for synthetic speech withstands reconstruction attacks; relevant only to organizations releasing TTS at scale.
items.unproven: Evaluation limited to autoregressive TTS; no assessment against adversarial watermark removal techniques or real-world distribution channels.

items.title: Topology-independent quantum advantage in communication networks
items.dek: Theoretical framework demonstrates topology-independent quantum advantage for three-party equality task.
items.unproven: Limited to toy three-party scenario; no practical communication system; does not establish advantage for real network constraints or protocols.

items.title: Sum-of-squares compilation of matrix-model dynamics for NISQ and fault-tolerant hardware
items.dek: Compilation techniques reduce two-qubit gate count for matrix-model dynamics on NISQ and fault-tolerant hardware.
items.unproven: Optimization specific to one potential family; no experimental validation on real hardware; relevance to general quantum cryptography or security applications unclear.

items.title: Majorana bilinears, compact modular seeds and the approach to the Tsirelson bound
items.dek: Theoretical analysis of Bell-CHSH inequality in Majorana field vacuum shows Tsirelson bound approached but not attained.
items.unproven: Pure theory with no hardware realization; no connection to practical quantum communication or cryptography; mathematical result without engineering path.

noise.title: OpenAI safety leader quits, warning AI company's culture is 'broken'
noise.dek: Personnel departure and organizational culture claim at AI vendor; does not affect SDLC tooling or process.

noise.title: Treachery in the Rodin Museum 3D scan verdict
noise.dek: Museum 3D scan metadata dispute; outside application security engineering scope entirely.

noise.title: The Escalation of War in Ethiopia
noise.dek: Political conflict in Ethiopia; not security-related.
